descriptor: Google Search, Meta lead generation, and appointment follow-up
status: Full-month Google delivery verified; Meta evidence covers two confirmed weekly windows
signal: Google Search generated 138 clicks from 2,393 impressions on $504.49 in August spend. Two verified Meta reporting windows added 11 paid form leads, while the full-month Meta spend total remains pending validation.
goal: Connect every paid inquiry to contact and appointment outcomes, then use appointment quality to guide September budget and creative decisions.

benchmark.detail: August Google CPC than the 2026 Apparel / Fashion & Jewelry search benchmark of $4.44.

work: Delivered weekly paid-media reports with Google and Meta kept as separate evidence lanes.
Prepared private lead handoffs so contact details stayed out of shared client reporting.
Maintained the Higher Intent Meta form and its qualification fields to improve inquiry quality.
Mapped the inquiry-to-appointment follow-up path so September decisions can use boutique outcomes.
analysis: Google Search produced a stable full-month traffic signal at $3.66 per click. The cost is efficient for the category, while appointment quality remains the decision metric that matters most.

The Meta evidence is useful but incomplete for the full month: Aug 3–9 recorded two leads at $34.40 per lead and Aug 17–23 recorded nine leads at $7.72 per lead. Those windows are not represented as a complete monthly total.

platforms.name: Google Ads
platforms.note: The Philadelphia Search campaign spent $504.49 for 138 clicks from 2,393 impressions, producing a 5.77% click-through rate and $3.66 average cost per click. Conversion reporting is pending validation.

platforms.name: Meta Ads
platforms.note: Two verified weekly reads recorded 11 paid form leads on $138.28 in spend. Direct full-month Meta access was unavailable, so this is a coverage floor rather than a monthly total.

outcome.platform: Google delivered 138 clicks on $504.49 in full-month spend. Two verified Meta windows delivered 11 paid form leads.
outcome.business: Contact, consultation, and booked-appointment outcomes are not yet reconciled to the monthly platform activity.
outcome.measurement: Match each inquiry to contact and appointment status, then evaluate budget and form quality from booked-consultation evidence.
